item.title: Jobs again
item.description: It’s been a long time now since I started looking for jobs. It doesn’t feel like I’ll get one anytime soon either. This life sucks, really. Having no money is one thing, but being degraded for not having a job is another. It’s not like I’m actively trying to sabotage my chances at a job. It’s that I almost never get one. When I tell my parents that one of my friends got a temporary underpaying job (which they probably got after a few dozen rejections while also being more qualified than me), they have the balls to point to that very example and says “See, everyone is taking care of their future. You are the only one who will be left behind.”
